newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates Toyota's 2002 Eurobond AAA.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Toyota's 2002 Eurobond AAA.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it assigned an Aaa rating to Toyota Motor Corporation's (Toyota) $1.0 billion Eurobond issue due 2002.

"Toyota's Aaa rating is supported by the group's position as the largest auto manufacturer in Japan and the third largest auto manufacturer in the world, and by its strong financial condition," Moody's said in a statement.

"Toyota maintains a relatively un-leveraged capital structure and high degree of balance sheet liquidity. At the same time, the rating recognises the pressure on Toyota's earnings through fiscal 1996 and the continued pressure on cash flow stemming from large investments in new products to reverse domestic share losses that had occurred through the early to mid-1990s," it said.
